Hence HS convergence is proved, including normalization changes and full-output tails, not inferred from finite numerical tests. The known weighted-Volterra Bessel boundary-value problem yields every fixed-index constant. The scalar Sturm-Liouville boundary conditions are stated and checked; the special function branch and fixed-rank quantifiers are correct. No subcritical infinite-operator boundedness is assumed.

Bessel constants are mathematically forced by the nontrivial Volterra continuum model, not arbitrary tabulated finite numbers or routine parameter substitutions.
